Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the clear asks. High-level answers below; I attached a short incident flow diagram and the SIG response table populated with the fields you called out. I'll loop in Legal for counsel specifics.

1) Triage window: Our on-call SRE/IR team prioritizes confirmed detections within a 2-hour operational triage window during business hours; for critical detections (e.g., active exfiltration or functional outage) we treat triage as immediate (target under 30 minutes). Outside business hours, our on-call rotation covers the same SLAs.

2) Notifier roles: Day-to-day triage & technical POC: SRE on-call (primary) / IR lead (secondary). Executive notification (customers, regulators): Head of Security / Legal. We maintain an escalation roster (rotates weekly) — sample contacts are in the attached flow doc.

3) External counsel: We do not maintain a single retained external counsel for every customer. For matters with potential regulatory exposure or cross-border data issues we engage our outside counsel (listed in the flow doc) and coordinate with the customer to confirm engagement. For lower-impact incidents we handle notifications internally per policy.

Preferred external notice SLA to customers: We do not promise a single fixed window in customer contracts; typical operational target is to provide initial customer notification within 72 hours of incident confirmation when legally permissible. If legal/regulatory withholding applies (e.g., active law enforcement investigation), we coordinate with counsel.

Attached: redwood_incident_flow_v2.pdf (flow + roster), sig_response_table.xlsx (populated)

Does that cover what you need for GreenFintech's procurement checklist? If so, I can mark the relevant SIG fields as evidence-linked.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
